title: Clear understanding and an unfamiliar picture

captions.physics: Considering discrepancies and sharing a conclusion
captions.emotions: Feeling unsettled by a changed picture

meaning: Your shared view can clearly understand weak earlier grounds while their revision still feels unsettling.
text: Clearly seeing weak grounds does not always mean immediately feeling new support. The Hermit in the physical position of Ajna suggests considering a discrepancy and sharing a conclusion. The Tower in energy motivates checking whether an earlier foundation holds. The Tower in emotions feels unsettled as a familiar picture changes. Her first role concerns establishing what actually supports an explanation; her second concerns responding to lost familiar certainty. You may already understand the mistake’s cause while finding the new picture difficult to hold as a whole.

Suppose you examine an old courtyard diagram. After reflection, one person notices that it is rotated relative to your familiar approach to the house. **An understandable clarification may still leave new footing unfelt.** You now see why the entrances’ arrangement seemed impossible. Yet the familiar courtyard seems to rearrange inwardly, which feels disorientating. Both can explain the diagram’s rotation while retaining a sense of unfamiliarity. Your shared view already distinguishes the earlier discrepancy’s cause while the emotional picture has yet to come together again.

The risk is repeatedly checking one premise, expecting repetition immediately to remove uncertainty. Inquiry becomes confined to what is already understood. Wanting to establish whether grounds hold preserves a distinction: an explanation can be clear while a new image still needs space within your familiar sense of a known place.
